params._comment: PLAN-C C13 dragon-victory shatter orbit, CUT-END restage: a world-anchored sweep around the End disc while the deterministic carve pass splits it into floating islets (EndShatterSequence supplies the play anchor = disc center at surface height, so keyframe positions are offsets from it). Played as a GLOBAL_TELEPORT group show with returnAfter — the C6 validatedReturnPosition healing covers the way home. Staging: t 0–0.10 is a DEAD-SILENT hold (no events; EndShatterSequence delays its own rumble/shake/seam flashes past the same window), the first crack lands at t 0.10, three more race outward with rising-weight shakes (freq 3.0→1.8: sharp rattles turning heavy), the separation pull leaves t 0.42 on easeInOutQuart into the wide+tilted t 0.72 apex (fov 79, roll 4), and the last two keyframes sink the camera ~5 blocks past its final height then lift it 3 back — the islet overshoot-and-settle read — under a low-frequency (0.4→0.35) rumble fade with a rift_thud settle thump at t 0.90. Settle legs run easeInOutSine (REPASS polish: the shipped easeOutSine legs entered at 3.4/1.7 blocks-per-tick off a dead stop — a visible lurch at the thud and at the sink turnaround; in-out keeps the same geometry with zero-velocity junctions, the turnaround passing through rest like a real overshoot).
params._doc: Per-keyframe 'fov' (degrees, default 70) is smoothly lerped along the flight by CameraDirector.onComputeFov and eases back into the player's own FOV at the end.
